what_works: Hero is a single looping silent video of work in motion behind oversized lockup type; portfolio thumbnails 'warp' on scroll into the next case. The video-as-hero pattern is exactly what a busy mobile mechanic or pest-control crew needs when they have phone footage but not editorial stills.
what_does_not_translate: The 'list warp' transformation on portfolio entries is a JS-heavy custom interaction — keep the silent-loop hero and the dark charcoal/cream contrast, skip the warp.
type_observations: One heavy grotesk display at 120-180px clamp; tiny mono-style labels for nav and metadata.
